question.prompt: If point \(P\) is equidistant from the two sides of \(\angle AOB\), must \(P\) lie on the angle bisector (\(P\) lies inside the angle)?

solutions.explanation: A point inside an angle that is equidistant from its two sides lies on the angle bisector. This is the angle bisector criterion.
solutions.title: Apply the angle-bisector criterion
